title: Delivered Page and Field Configurator mappings can predate the configurator's current rules until the configuration is saved again
statement: A delivered configuration's Event Mapping is what the release that generated it mapped; services the current configurator adds (EOCC_FIELDCHANGE, numbered EOCC_ROWINITn/ROWINSERTn) are missing until the configuration is saved again, which regenerates it. A comparison of stored with derived mappings must allow for that.

observations.observation: HRDMO: JOB_DATA_FL's mappings were generated 2020-09-25 and lack only EOCC_FIELDCHANGE on DERIVED_JOB_HDR.ACTION (the service was delivered 2020-12-14); EE_HR_PROC_FL's were generated 2017-07-31 and hold only PostBuild, before EOCC_ROWINIT1 and the others (2021-08-25). Neither has a stored row the rules do not derive.
